component.name: Vix Mix
component.summary: Mix microphones and apps through VST3 plugins on PipeWire

description.p: Vix Mix is a desktop mixer for streaming and calls. Up to eight input channels, each a microphone or a group of apps, run through their own chain of VST3 plugins into two mixes: Monitor, which you hear, and Master, which plays to your main output and is also a virtual microphone other apps record.

ul.li: An app is routed to its channel the moment it starts, and back when Vix Mix quits
Two sends per channel, each with its own level and mute
A plugin chain on every channel and on both mixes
Master as a virtual microphone named Vix Mix Master for calls and recording
The whole setup, plugin settings included, saved as you go

description.p: It uses PipeWire's native API and loads the VST3 plugins installed on the machine, Windows plugins bridged by yabridge included.
The first build: the console, PipeWire routing and VST3 chains, before the first test on a real Fedora desktop.
